correctness.rationale: With K=2^r and eps=1/(qK), floor(K(j-eps*j))=Kj-ceil(j/q), so transition j->j-1 has exactly p_j=ceil(j/q)/K (valid because j<qK) and independent geometric holding times. Their product pgf, first two moments and q-fold exponential-block decomposition follow directly. Fixed q gives maxima of exponentials and the stated q-averaged Gumbel shifted by -log(q); uniform coupling requires n/K->0. For q->infinity a Lyapunov ratio bounded by const/min(q,n)^(1/2) proves Gaussian, including q>=n negative-binomial range. A small exact rational check with n=11,q=2,K=8 matches the stated kernel and geometric moments. Correctness is supported by the proof, not logs.
